messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — Solaris (enterprise POC) asked for a variant of nova-70b tuned for long context (64k), quantized to 4-bit, with KMS integration and private VPC deployment. Need: compatibility check, SLA/price ballpark, and security questionnaire answers. Can someone own?

samuel: I can take compatibility. short checklist: tokenizer match, kv-cache sharding, 4-bit q-inference path, and whether the model uses RMSNorm->fast path. Do they need persistent KV caching across requests?

elaine: They want session-level KV reuse across a user session (not long-term). Also require token-auditing and audit logs in private deploy.

samuel: ok. initial hunch: nova-70b 4-bit works on our quant runtime but long-context 64k needs chunked attention or ALiBi fallback; we have a compatible variant (nova-70b-long) but it's untested at scale. I'll run a quick variant sweep.

kevin: FYI infra notes — private deploy + KMS + audit-logs is doable, but requires Dedicated plan + Private control plane. For 64k context with batching we need >= A100-80GB or M200 nodes and recommend pinned capacity. Ballpark: estimate reserved = $220k/month, canary pool ~12k USD/day for burst.

marta: Security Qs — Solaris sent an infosec questionnaire. Key asks: data residency, KMS/HSM, audit trails, vulnerability scanning, and SOC2 details. I can draft answers but need specifics on where logs live and retention.

samuel: Running local test: command

`````
# run nvbench for nova-70b-long
redwood-run --model nova-70b-long --quant 4 --context 65536 --profile kv-cache
`````

samuel: Early run shows memory pressure on kv cache >80k tokens, fallback latency spikes. Suggest we propose 32k as safe default unless we isolate to dedicated M200 pool.

elaine: Can we fast-track a canary? Solaris wants a POC next week. They also asked for pricing per 1M tokens and a reserved capacity quote for 3 months.

kevin: For canary: prioritize a single dedicated pool (2x M200) for 3 days — infra estimate is 12k USD/day for burst. For committed 3-month reserved, ops says ~220k/month (very rough). I'll refine after Samuel's performance numbers.

marta: I'll start the security questionnaire draft. If we offer token-level auditing, we need to confirm retention options (30/90/365 days). Which options do we expose?

samuel: We can expose 30 and 90 today, 365 requires storage add-on; I'll note that in answers. Also quant fallback behavior is important — we should warn about occasional 1.5x latency when kv misses.

elaine: Awesome. Owners: samuel -> compatibility & perf runs; kevin -> infra quote & canary ops; marta -> security Qs; I'll coordinate Solaris and package pricing. I'll loop legal if they want an NDA.

deploy-bot: canary request queued: canary-1743214321-solaris | owner=kevin | duration=72h

samuel: I'll post perf logs in #eng-runtime once bam. preliminary numbers will be ready by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: thanks team — please keep thread updates short. I'll update Solaris after EOD perf. :thumbsup:
